Goal `core-math-1-3`, stage 2 (the dossier). `Core\Math::abs` and `Core\Math::acos` have every feature proof on disk: `about.md`, three examples, one attack, one bench with a recorded figure, a Rust `#[test]` with a `covers:` marker in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/math.rs`'s test module, and help. `Core\Math` now has its class card (`CARD`, above `CLASS`), so the class-card part of help is done for every member of the class.
`abs`'s example 03 carries `// proof: gap nvs-stdlib/math-abs-result-is-the-whole-union`. `abs` is typed `int|float|decimal` whatever it is given, so `decimal $owed = Core\Math::abs($x)` does not compile. The attack and the bench convert with `as int`. The fix needs a bounded type variable, which is a design question (M10).
Member cards are being rewritten in plain words as each member is taken (`ABS_DOC`, `ACOS_DOC` done). Do the same for each card you take.
The pack's acceptance failure (`[12 no Python]`) was stale. `bun nv audit python` prints what that check wants.
